en.只花 0.25 元，就让 DSH 救活了 Hermes Agent: For Just RMB 0.25, DSH Brought My Hermes Agent Back to Life
en.上一篇文章里，我尝试让两个 Agent 在同一个云端环境中配合工作：: In my previous post, I tried having two agents work together in the same cloud environment.
en.Hermes Agent 担任领航员，负责理解需求、设计方案和检查结果；Deep: Hermes Agent acted as the navigator, understanding requirements, designing the plan, and checking the results. DeepSeek Harness (DSH for short) acted as the driver, working inside the actual workspace to write and verify code.
en.别再让Agent单干了！我让Hermes和DSH组队后，效率提升了10倍: Stop Letting Your Agent Work Alone! Teaming Up Hermes and DSH Made Me 10 Times More Efficient
en.一个新问题的出现，让这套组合给了我一个新的灵感。: A new problem gave me another idea for this pairing.
en.问题的起因是近来有数位社群内小伙伴的 Hermes Agent 出现了如下的一些: Recently, several people in our community ran into errors like these from their Hermes Agent:
en.第一种：No reply: the turn was stopped becau: First error: No reply: the turn was stopped because session storage could not be written (the transcript would have been lost on restart). Check the state database health (hermes doctor), then send your message again.
en.第二种：Session storage was temporarily unav: Second error: Session storage was temporarily unavailable, so this turn was stopped to protect your conversation history. Your message should already be saved - please send it again in a moment.
en.究其原因都是因为 Hermes Agent 的一个文件（state.db）因为种: Both errors came down to the same issue: for various reasons, a Hermes Agent file, state.db, could no longer be written to or read. To protect existing data, Hermes Agent then blocked further conversations. More frustratingly, rebuilding the agent from LightVela’s Diagnostic Center did not fix it either.
en.这个情况在此之前是非常棘手的，直到有了同一个环境下的 DeepSeek Harn: This used to be a difficult problem, until we had DeepSeek Harness running in the same environment.
en.要解决前面的问题，使用 Hermes Agent 原生的修复机制即可完成，棘手的: Hermes Agent’s native recovery mechanism can fix this problem. The difficult part is starting that recovery process from inside the environment where Hermes Agent runs.
en.DSH 与 Hermes Agent 运行在同一个环境下，它能够接触 Herme: DSH runs in the same environment as Hermes Agent. It can access Hermes processes, logs, configuration, and files, and it can execute commands. That means we can hand the repair task directly to DSH.
en.你可以参考上一篇推文，先在 LightVela 中安装并配置好 DSH：: Follow the previous post to install and configure DSH in LightVela first:
en.注意，这里让 DSH 解决问题时，需要确保在 /home/agentuser/: When asking DSH to troubleshoot, make sure its working directory is /home/agentuser/.
en.这里有一步可选的增强配置，就是先给 DSH 一本 Hermes Agent 的操: One optional improvement is to give DSH a Hermes Agent operations manual first. This saves it from having to figure out the configuration on its own. To install it, enter this in the DSH chat:
en.安装完成之后，先让它来做第一步：: Once installation is complete, start with this request:
en.你当前的运行环境中，存在一个 Hermes Agent，你先找到它的安装位置，我: There is a Hermes Agent in your current runtime environment. Find its installation location first. Using the skill you just installed, help me diagnose and resolve a problem.
en.当然，如果你想要稍微稳一点，可以这样告诉它：: If you would like to proceed a little more cautiously, you can say:
en.你当前的运行环境中，存在一个 Hermes Agent，你先找到它的安装位置，我:
There is a Hermes Agent in your current runtime environment. Find its installation location first. Using the skill you just installed, help me diagnose and resolve this problem:
{Describe your problem here}.

First investigate the cause and propose a repair plan. Do not execute it yet.
en.等它告诉你实际的修复方案，如果拿不准可以在交流群里问问群友（文末扫码可以加入）。: Wait for it to explain the repair plan. If you are unsure, ask in the community group; you can join using the QR code at the end of this post.
en.我这里进行得比较顺利，我的 DSH 在查找 Hermes Agent 之后就已经: My repair went smoothly. After locating Hermes Agent, DSH had already identified the damaged state.db and laid out the repair plan and steps. It then got to work:
en.并且在数分钟内已经最终修复完了：: Within a few minutes, the repair was complete:
en.Token 消耗的情况大概是，全程消耗了 2.6M Token（输入）、31.3: The whole process used about 2.6M input tokens and 31.3K output tokens, with a 97% cache hit rate, which is very high. I used DeepSeek-V4 Flash, so the total cost was only about RMB 0.25. Compared with asking an expert for help or spending hours troubleshooting it myself, that was very inexpensive.
en.当然，最后我们还是要回到 Hermes Agent 的对话窗口内，来确定问题是否: Finally, return to the Hermes Agent chat to confirm that the problem really is fixed:
en.欢迎各位探险家加入 LightVela 交流群，一起探索云端 Agent 的新鲜: Join the LightVela community to explore new ways to use cloud agents together.
en.我的两个 Agent，结伴参与了“鹈鹕杯”: My Two Agents Entered the Pelican Cup Together
en.我在 LightVela 中让 Hermes Agent 与 DSH 组队，生成: I teamed up Hermes Agent and DSH in LightVela to create and submit a cycling pelican animation.
en.鹈鹕测试最初是由社区开发者针对可能存在的大模型“降智”问题，提出的一个非正式模型: The pelican test began as an informal model capability test proposed by community developers concerned about language models becoming less capable. The core task is to have an agent draw a pelican riding a bicycle entirely through code, then judge the model’s performance by the details of the result.
en.在 OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra 之后，鹈鹕测试最近又火起来了，更: After OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, the pelican test gained attention again. Developers in the community even launched a Pelican Cup competition, attracting coverage from technology media.
en.不过看了一圈好像也没有教大家怎么样具体参与，于是想到了前几天在 LightVel: I looked around but could not find much guidance on how to enter. Then I remembered the Hermes Agent and DSH team I had set up in LightVela a few days earlier. A coding competition seemed like a good fit for them.
en.如果你也想按照我的思路参加鹈鹕杯，不妨先参考这篇推文，来组起这个队伍来：: If you want to enter the Pelican Cup using the same approach, start with this post to put your team together:
en.当然，如果你嫌麻烦，只在 LightVela 里创建一个 Hermes Agen: If that feels like too much setup, you can also just create a Hermes Agent in LightVela and work with it through chat.
en.你在这里，你可以先安装我的skill，我把LightVela参与鹈鹕杯提交作品的: You can start by installing my skill. I turned the process of submitting a Pelican Cup entry from LightVela into a skill to make it easier to use. Send your agent this message:
en.当然，这里为了确保比赛的公平性，本身SVG的打磨还是由模型自己来决断，技能中就没: To keep the competition fair, the model still decides how to refine the SVG itself. That part is not included in the skill.
en.其实我的提示词很简单，完全让模型发挥自己的水准和审美：: My prompt was simple, leaving the model free to use its own abilities and visual judgment:
en.调用 DSH 创建一个HTML，内容是SVG绘制一个鹈鹕骑自行车的2D动画（可基: Call DSH to create an HTML page containing an SVG-based 2D animation of a pelican riding a bicycle. You may interpret the brief creatively and refine it over several rounds. Once you are satisfied, use the Pelican Cup For Vela skill to submit it for me at https://codexradar.com/cup/.
en.在它俩精妙的配合下，大概用了 20 分钟左右，花了 5 块钱左右的 Token，: Working together, the two agents spent about 20 minutes and roughly RMB 5 in tokens. After two rounds of refinement, they submitted the entry.
en.emm 并没有我想象得那么好，但距离网络上的一些大师作品还是相去甚远，看来我有必: Well, it was not quite as good as I had imagined, and it was still a long way from some of the outstanding entries online. Looks like I should try a better model next time!
en.为了方便大家真实地感受我的参赛作品，我在 LightVela 上也把它发布出来了: To let everyone try the actual entry, I also published it through LightVela so it can be accessed through a domain.
en.要实现起来也很简单，给你的 Agent 发送以下内容即可 Get 同款：: That is easy to do. Send your agent the following message to do the same:
en.使用 website-builder Skill 帮我部署下刚刚这个鹈鹕的 HT: Use the website-builder Skill to deploy the pelican HTML page we just created.
en.不得不说这就是云端的好处之一，有一些前端生成的小项目，随时随地就能放在云上让大家: This is one advantage of working in the cloud: small frontend projects can be made available online for others to visit whenever you want.
en.不过需要提醒大家，如果大家是 LightVela 国内版，那么这个链接是只有你自: One thing to keep in mind: on the China version of LightVela, the link is only accessible to you.
en.鹈鹕测试的初衷是为了长期观测对比模型的生成效果，社区中有玩家甚至会每天生成一份留: The pelican test was originally intended to track and compare model output over time. Some people in the community generate and save one every day, looking for noticeable changes that might suggest a change in the model’s capabilities.
en.那我是不是可以创建一个定时任务，让我的 Agent 小分队每天都生成一次，过一段: Could I set up a scheduled task and have my agent team generate one every day? After a while, that might give me a better sense of how the model I use day to day performs.
en.先埋个坑，过段时间发出来看看效果。: I will leave that idea here for now and share the results another time.
en.图源社区，侵删: Image from the community; will remove on request.
en.结对编程让一个人写代码、另一个人审阅，从而提升设计质量。我尝试把同样的协作方式用: Pair programming can improve design quality: one person writes the code while the other reviews it. I tried applying that same approach to agents.
en.刚开始学习软件工程的时候，课本中的概念告诉我们结对编程相比于程序员独立工作，往往: When I first studied software engineering, the textbooks taught us that pair programming often produces better designs and better code than working alone. The person typing is usually called the driver, while the person reviewing the code is the observer.
en.这种协作模式在拉力比赛中同样存在，每辆赛车内有一名驾驶员和一名领航员，相互配合，: The same kind of collaboration exists in rally racing. Each car has a driver and a navigator, working together with a roadbook to find their way through a demanding course.
en.结对编程和拉力赛展现了相似的协作思路：让一个角色专注眼前执行，另一个角色持续观察: Pair programming and rally racing share a similar approach: one person focuses on execution while the other watches the bigger picture, anticipates what comes next, and corrects course when needed. By sharing the same environment and staying in sync, they reduce the mental workload and the cost of mistakes in complex tasks.
en.沿着这个思路，当 Hermes Agent 和 DeepSeek Harness: Following that idea, Hermes Agent and DeepSeek Harness can form a similar partnership when they share context, divide the work, and hand over control within the same task environment in LightVela.
en.LightVela 现已提供了在同一云端环境下同时运行 Hermes Agent: LightVela now supports running Hermes Agent and DeepSeek Harness (DSH for short) in the same cloud environment, making it possible to explore this kind of collaboration.
en.Hermes Agent 的明显优势是“持续理解一个人和一件事”。它可以保留用户: Hermes Agent is good at maintaining an ongoing understanding of a person and their work. It can retain preferences and project knowledge, capture working methods in Skills, and keep receiving tasks through chat channels. That makes it well suited to the navigator role.
en.DSH 的明显特点是对具体的工作区负责，并在此基础上可以读取和修改文件、修改文件: DSH focuses on a specific workspace. It can read and edit files, run tests, handle errors, and perform other tasks within that workspace, making it a better fit for the driver role.
en.如何实现：准备工作: How to Set It Up: Preparation
en.先叠个甲，实现协作需要安装一个技能和工具来完成，属于一种探索型的方案，适用于 A: A quick caveat: this setup requires installing a skill and a tool. It is an experimental approach for people who enjoy exploring AI and do not mind tinkering. A more polished product experience is still being designed.
en.如果你接着往下看，那么我认为你会想要试试它的效果，不过丑话说在前面，因为 AI: If you are still reading, you probably want to try it. Just keep in mind that AI can be unpredictable, so following every step does not guarantee success. If you run into trouble, ask your AI to help solve it. You are part of the collaboration too!
en.首先你需要在 LightVela 中首先建一个自己的 Agent，不过不需要担心: First, create your own agent in LightVela. Getting started is straightforward: the China site supports WeChat, QQ, and phone login, while the international site supports Google and GitHub login. A free trial is available as well.
en.这里个人推荐直接选 4500 积分的版本，亲测很耐蹬。: I recommend choosing the version with 4,500 credits. In my experience, they last quite a while.
en.订阅完成后，来到探索页面，可以看到 DeepSeek Harness 的入口，进: After subscribing, go to Explore and find DeepSeek Harness. Open its page and install it.
en.安装过程大概1-3分钟，实测很快，大概1分钟左右：: Installation takes about one to three minutes. In my test, it finished in around a minute:
en.安装完成后，可以在同一页面内给 DSH 配置模型、访问 WebUI 等：: Once it is installed, you can configure a model for DSH and open its WebUI from the same page:
en.编者按：这里的产品体验还不足够好，需要给 DSH 配置自己的模型，目前我们还没找: Editor’s note: this part of the experience still needs improvement. DSH requires its own model configuration, and we have not yet found a good way to synchronize model settings.
I used DeepSeek’s official model here: the newly released DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. It supports multimodal input natively and is reasonably priced. I will skip the configuration details and leave the link here:
en.如果想配置更多模型的话，也可以直接去 WebUI 里配置，也很简单。: To configure more models, you can also go directly to the WebUI. That is straightforward too.
en.访问 WebUI，这里的地址也不需要担心别人拿到了可以访问，我们给大家分配了一个: When opening the WebUI, you do not have to worry about someone gaining access just by obtaining the URL. LightVela assigns you a dedicated domain and adds authentication, so only you can use it:
en.如何实现：关键一步: How to Set It Up: The Key Step
en.简单来说，这一步是要安装一个技能，安装动作会完成两件事情：把 DSH 注册为一个: The next step is to install a skill that does two things: register DSH as a Hermes Agent tool, and teach Hermes Agent how to call it.
en.这个方案只是目前基于 Hermes Agent 已有机制的设想之一，技能和工具是: This is just one approach based on the mechanisms Hermes Agent currently provides. I built the skill and tool through vibe coding. If you run into usability problems or have ideas for a better approach, join the LightVela community to discuss them.
en.将以下这段话复制并发给 LightVela 里的 Hermes Agent，即可: Copy the following message and send it to your Hermes Agent in LightVela to initialize the setup:
en.如果你懒得配聊天通道，那也可以在“对话”页面直接发送给 Hermes Agent: If you do not want to configure a chat channel, you can send it directly to Hermes Agent from the Chat page:
en.安装完成后的效果大致如下，一般会需要检查一下 DSH 的状态，Agent 问的话: The result should look roughly like this. It will usually need to check DSH’s status. If the agent asks, confirm that it should proceed:
en.然后注册完成后，还需要让 Hermes Agent 把新注册的工具设置为可用状态: After registration, ask Hermes Agent to enable the newly registered tool:
en.开启完成后 Agent 也会告诉你：: The agent will let you know once it is enabled:
en.如何使用：各显其能: How to Use It: Let Each Agent Do Its Part
en.个人建议可以搭配 LightVela 里的工作台使用。工作台提供了一个静态网页托: I suggest using it with LightVela’s Workbench. Workbench supports hosting static websites, so projects generated by your agent can be deployed directly to the cloud. Support for deploying backend services is planned for later.
en.这里仅作简单演示，你可以尝试把下面的话复制并发给你的 Hermes Agent：: For a simple demonstration, try copying this message to your Hermes Agent:
en.使用刚刚安装的技能，帮我实现一个简单的静态博客页面，你来设计方案，由 DeepS:
Use the skill we just installed to build a simple static blog page. You design the plan, have DeepSeek Harness write the code, and then review it.

Once it is complete, deploy it using the website-builder Skill.
en.按正常的情况，它俩开始协作的效果类似这样：: When everything works as expected, their collaboration looks something like this:
en.成功完成一次任务后应该是这样的：: After a successful task, you should see something like this:
en.它当然是可以访问的，只是略显简陋：: The site is accessible, though the result is still fairly basic:
en.更多的场景玩法就留给大家来探索吧，本文仅作为思路上的抛砖引玉。: I will leave more scenarios for you to explore. This post is simply a starting point for trying the approach.

zh-CN.LightVela: Your Personal AI in the Cloud: LightVela：你的云端个人 AI 助手正式上线
zh-CN.LightVela is a personal AI assistant tha: LightVela 是一款独立运行在云端的个人 AI 助手，持续在线，记住你的习惯，并主动为你处理事务。
zh-CN.LightVela began with the wave of interes: LightVela 的起点，是 OpenClaw 掀起的个人 AI 热潮。
zh-CN.In March this year, we hosted our first: 今年 3 月，我们在深圳腾讯大厦举办了首场 OpenClaw 免费安装活动，很快吸引了来自全国的关注。
zh-CN.In April, based on cloud agent, we launc: 4 月，我们基于云端 Agent 推出以 Hermes Agent 为基础的 LightVela，国内站和国际站同步上线。部署、配置和维护都由我们处理，让每个人都能在短短 10 秒内创建一个持续在线的个人 AI 助手。
zh-CN.A dedicated cloud computer with at least: 一台至少配备 2 核 CPU、8GB 内存的专属云电脑
zh-CN.Invite a friend to sign up and activate: 邀请好友注册并激活 LightVela，你和好友都能获得 500 AI 积分，邀请奖励没有上限！
zh-CN.You can assign tasks to LightVela anytim: 通过你习惯使用的聊天软件，随时把任务交给 LightVela。它在云端持续运行，记住你的偏好，定时收集新闻、跟踪动态、发送提醒。
zh-CN.Not Sure What AI Can Do for You? Start w: 不知道 AI 能为你做什么？从一个 Bot 开始
zh-CN.When you create your LightVela agent, yo: 创建 LightVela Agent 时，你可以选择围绕日常需求设计的现成 Bot 模板，包括育儿顾问、健康管家、行业研究员和增长实验员。
zh-CN.or Github into practical templates, wit: 或 GitHub 中挑选热门技能，组合成实用模板，提前配置好人设、技能、记忆和定时任务。无需额外设置，点击即可开始使用。
zh-CN.Every Agent Has Its Own Cloud Environmen: 每个 Agent 都有自己的云端环境
zh-CN.LightVela is built on the open-source ag: LightVela 基于开源 Agent 框架 Hermes Agent 构建。每个 Agent 还拥有独立的云端环境，可以执行这些日常任务：
zh-CN.Putting together an industry news briefi: 每天早上整理一份行业新闻简报。
zh-CN.Checking stocks, websites, or competitor: 定时查看股票、网站或竞品动态。
zh-CN.Reminding you to log your meals and exer: 晚上提醒你记录饮食和运动。
zh-CN.Background tasks keep running even when: 即使电脑关机，后台任务也会继续运行。腾讯云成熟的云服务器基础设施，以及运营百万核规模云端 Agent CPU 集群的经验，为这些能力提供支持。
zh-CN.LightVela co-hosted an online meetup wit: LightVela 与新加坡高校联合举办了一场线上交流活动，Hermes 核心团队成员 Tommy 也参与其中。
zh-CN.Use It Your Way, with Support for Multip: 按你的方式使用，支持多个 Bot
zh-CN.LightVela lets you customize your agent’: 你可以自定义 LightVela Agent 的灵魂、记忆、技能和定时任务。它会持续适应你的偏好、习惯和交流方式，用得越多，就越了解你。
zh-CN.When there is more to do, you can create: 事情多的时候，你可以创建多个 Bot：一个负责行业研究，一个规划旅行，另一个处理日常事务。每个 Bot 都有独立的记忆、技能和任务，彼此的上下文不会混在一起。
zh-CN.Different Bots can connect to channels s: 不同 Bot 可以连接 Telegram、Discord 等聊天通道，也可以加入同一个群聊，组成你的 AI 小队。
zh-CN.Beyond conversations and task execution,: 除了对话和执行任务，LightVela 还提供了工作台。
zh-CN.Choose a template or build a page from s: 你可以选择模板，也可以从零搭建页面，随后发布、预览、更新和管理。旅行计划、个人主页、项目页面和信息看板，都可以通过公开访问链接分享。
zh-CN.New users currently receive a one-month: 新用户目前可以免费试用一个月，包含一台 2 核 CPU、8GB 内存的云电脑，以及 4,500 AI 积分。邀请好友注册并激活账号，你和好友都能额外获得 500 AI 积分，邀请奖励没有上限。
